newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon ups Barclays target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon ups Barclays target.

text.p: Salomon Brothers raised its price target for banking group Barclays Plc to 10.50 stg from 10.00, a research note from analyst John Leonard at the brokerage said on Wednesday.

The note said a recent analyst seminar had highlighted Barclays' wide-ranging programmes to improve operating returns in two of its major business units, the personal sector unit of UK banking services and asset management.
It said similar efforts to refocus and improve the operating efficiency of Barclays' broad business lines were underway in other units.
Bank stocks have already outperformed the rest of the UK market in recent months, yet Salomon said this outperformance could continue against a background of declining bond yields and low inflation.
"We continue to have a high degree of confidence that Barclays' internal processes will continue to build returns, with a particularly low risk of an expensive acquisition mistake," the note said.
It repeated a longer-term "buy" recommendation on the stock and set a price target of 10.50 stg within six to 12 months.
The stock was down 1p at 10.03 stg by 0930 GMT.
Salomon expects Barclays pre-tax profit to rise to 2.365 billion stg in 1996 from 2.083 billion a year before.
